Unfortunately, his theory is quickly debunked when Sissy and his moms are kidnapped by the actual bad guys – culminating in an epic race down the Autobahn to save Frostee’s family!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Cisco’s been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Phil learns no one on the farm thinks he's fun, he sets out to prove them all wrong... by building a crazy amusement park.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Eep and Dawn find a stranded egg, they eagerly take it in as their new pet, but when they learn the egg is not what it seems, they have to return it before it becomes dangerous.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Grug overhears Thunk accidentally call Phil "Dad", he tries to reconnect with Thunk by taking him to the natural spectacle known as "Big Shine."

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom attempts to defeat the World Serpent by emulating Hiccup.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom and the dragon riders foster displaced Hidden Realm dragons in Rakke Town but things get complicated when Mr. Rakke makes a surprise visit.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Right before basketball tryouts, Peng learns from NaiNai that it is his “big bad” year on the zodiac calendar – which means bad luck. Peng is skeptical at first, but after seeing the positive effects of adhering to NaiNai’s superstitions, he dives headfirst into learning all he can to secure his spot on the team. Eventually, he becomes so consumed that he “breaks up” with Yi and Jin because of their zodiac incompatibility. Cut from tryouts, Peng eventually realizes with the help of his friends that he went overboard and he has more to offer than just basketball.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew’s life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. Overwhelmed by her efforts to help her mom and NaiNai in the shop, Yi asks the toad to spit up helpful items – but Jin and Peng aren’t so selfless. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue. Realizing the error of their ways and why the toad appeared in the first place, Yi and Everest use their magic to reverse the toad’s magic onto himself so he can wish himself home.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Sandra insists on breaking the gender barrier of a “boys only” skateboard race. But the race is one with a history for being incredibly dangerous. Will Sandra let Liam “save” her or will she save her reputation as the coolest sk8terchick at Cosmos High?

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A little white lie told to his ping-pong loving grandmother forces Raffi to actually try out for the team when they make the finals. Grandma is keen to see her favourite grandson play her favourite sport and he's not about to let her down. It soon becomes apparent that normally athletic Raffi is all thumbs when it comes to what team captain Antoine pretentiously refers to as table tennis.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and love is in the air at Cosmos High. When the other pods pressure Sandra and Raffi to couple-up, lovelorn Birch and Liam decide to take matters into their own hands ensuring that the reluctant pair don't end up together.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A cute guy into comics mistakes Birch's artwork as Sandra's comic. When the ruse is revealed, he falls for Birch. Sandra's ire rises, but both girls ultimately find out they've got a High School Lothario on their hands and reveal him to the sisterhood of Cosmos High.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia and Francine both volunteer to be classroom pet monitor, so the teacher, Mrs. Hogenmuller, tells them each to explain why they deserve the job. Francine initially wins over the class with the help of her charming cat, Gwendolyn, but when it's revealed that Francine is afraid of the class lizard, everyone is happy for Olivia to take over the job - especially Francine!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When school is let out early due to snow, Julian and Francine come over to Olivia's house. Olivia has the perfect game for them – Hotel! She transforms her house into a make-believe hotel. But then some strange things start to happen. Does the hotel have ghosts, or is Ian just playing tricks on them?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Mother is busy planning a birthday party for Francine, and Olivia wants to help. The big surprise – TV star Kicky the Kangaroo -is due to make a special appearance. But when unexpected problems confront Kicky, Olivia has to step in and save Francine's party!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: In preparation for their class track and field day – dubbed the “Hogenmuller Games” after their teacher -Olivia uses a unique training regiment to help her best friend Julian be the fastest runner he can be and to give herself a jump on the competition in her own event.

programme.desc: When things don't quite go according to plan, Po and the Kids must rally with other allies to save the Empress and protect China.

programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Guy invents a primitive skateboard, Eep and Dawn have a blast trying new tricks. But when the punch monkeys want to take over the girl's awesome new skate spot, Dawn and the punch monkeys enter a skate-off to win back the skate canyon once and for all.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom and the riders must finally overcome their differences and come together as a team to survive the Dark Realm.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: On the brink of his highly-anticipated White Coat Ceremony at school, Jin proudly dons his new white doctor’s coat around town, unwittingly drawing the attention of a creature named Morty. After a slobbery lick from Morty, Jin turns invisible! As Jin frantically tries to become re-visible, he discovers that Morty is very pregnant! Ultimately, Jin foregoes his ceremony and instead delivers Morty’s five babies.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Already stretched thin between responsibilities, Yi discovers one of Morty’s babies still in her building. She attempts to juggle her various responsibilities dumpling shop work, violin, magical creature childcare!), but it’s too much and she accidentally “loses” Mini-Morty. She’s going to need help from Jin and Peng to find Mini-Morty and return the baby creature to her mother.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Liam lets a misunderstanding about his upcoming “day surgery” escalate. Soon, the other students are sure his demise is inevitable and are treating him with kid gloves. As he enjoys the increased attention and sympathy, Birch becomes increasingly exasperated threatening to expose her cousin and his lies.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: With Birch's support Liam tries out at the teen open mike night at the local comedy club — and bombs. His chief Heckler, Raffi, gets invited back — as an act! The race to centre stage is on and Liam's not getting any traction, until he lets himself stumble, illuminating the physical side of his comedy.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Pod 4's plan to go to a movie gets derailed when Birch realizes she's “lost” her diary. Realizing it's in the office of The Cosmos Chronicle, Birch enlists the help of the others to intercept the newspaper before it gets distributed! The race is on to see if Birch can save herself from imminent disaster.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Eavesdropping, Birch misinterprets a conversation between her cousin and Raffi. She convinces herself that Raffi is in love with her justifying his increasingly odd behaviour as signs of his affection. By the time she finds out why he's scavenging for special labels, Birch has their entire future mapped out.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: On a school trip to the aquarium, Olivia and her classmates compete to be the first to view all the exhibits and win a chance to help feed the sea-lions. Olivia is partnered with Francine, and the two girls have to reconcile their different approaches in order to win the prize.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: It's Olivia's parents' anniversary, and they're planning a night out at a special restaurant. When they can't find a babysitter, Grandma happily volunteers. When Olivia suggests they all surprise Mum and Dad at dinner, she discovers the restaurant isn't at all the way she imagined, but it's a lot more fun!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is inspired after a visit to the museum with her family, and decides she's going to become a great painter herself. She gets right down to business, painting a portrait of Ian. programme.title: Accused S2
programme.desc: Based on the BBC's BAFTA-winning crime anthology, Accused opens in a courtroom on the accused, with viewers knowing nothing about their crime or how they ended up on trial. Told from the defendant's point of view through flashbacks, this series holds a mirror up to the current times with evocative and emotional stories. In Accused, viewers discover how an ordinary person gets caught up in an extraordinary situation, ultimately revealing how one wrong turn leads to another, until it's too late to turn back.

programme.title: Global Soul Kitchen (S1)

programme.desc: History’s boldest missions succeeded because the world looked away. The CIA hid covert missions behind Air America’s façade; British intelligence planted a fake invasion plan on a corpse to mislead Hitler.

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: Resistance to Nazi occupation and oppression is a constant throughout the war, with results both triumphant and devastating.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries (S5)
programme.desc: The Titanic's story captures the imagination of the public and experts of all kinds, who—decades after the ship's demise—still seek answers. Can new evidence reveal more about how the Titanic sank?

programme.title: History's Greatest Warriors
programme.desc: The Mongol's skill in horseback archery and mobility build him into the most elite fighter of his time. Emerging in the 13th century under Genghis Khan, the Mongol utilises advanced tactics and discipline.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens (S16)
programme.desc: Ancient Astronaut Theorist Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at The Top Ten Extraordinary Creatures that just might provide compelling evidence of extraterrestrial visitation.

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner (S3)
programme.desc: A vast majority of these strange and disturbing incidents take place in the same locations on Earth. Is it possible that extraterrestrial spacecraft are visiting Earth at so-called 'UFO Hot Spots'?

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd (S2)
programme.desc: We've heard the tales of great wars fought with groundbreaking weaponry, but what about everything else in between? Like missiles manned by pigeons to a helmet outfitted with firearms.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries (S7)
programme.desc: In the stories going back hundreds of years, this elusive creature has terrorised sailors and baffled scientists. Is this predator the stuff of legend… or could the Kraken be real?

programme.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters (S2)
programme.desc: The team heads to a target they believe to be the long-lost Marine Sulphur Queen. This massive tanker disappeared in 1963 with a crew of 39 and is one of the most iconic missing Bermuda Triangle wrecks.

programme.title: The Curse Of Oak Island (S12)
programme.desc: Optimism abounds when the Fellowship returns to Smith's Cove and finds evidence of work that could finally uncover the legendary flood tunnels and lead them directly to the Money Pit.

programme.title: Alone (S11)
programme.desc: With new weather patterns looming, the days are numbered for those counting on foraging to pull them through. One survivalist is left confused as the Arctic takes back its gift.

programme.title: Un Bon Garcon
programme.desc: Max, a talented 16-year-old swimmer, is getting ready to enter the sports studies programme. Between training sessions and outings with his friends, he leads the life of an average teenager. But when the police turn up one day to question his coach, who has been accused of sexual abuse, his regulated life is turned upside down.

programme.title: Foreigners
programme.desc: Jim, 15, is deeply shaken by the arrival of Neil, his British father whom he hasn't seen in five years. The teenager is about to be adopted by his stepfather, with whom he has formed a true bond. But Neil refuses to give up his parental rights...

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Stephane tries to calm several Tourette syndrome crises and has to solve a problem with glasses. Meanwhile, Mike fancies himself a poet, and Caro mourns the loss of a loved one.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Tired of being labeled the worst swimmer, Stephane quits the club. Charles finds an innovative solution to protect Catherine's hair, while Pierre invites the team to make a powerful video to raise donations.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Mike's wheelchair has been stolen. Valerie suggests a solution to help him out. It's time for the club's board meeting in the locker room: an opportunity to gather or just to snack? A special guest puts Stephane in his place.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Sarah receives a very special trophy to reward her efforts. The team is preparing a surprise for Emmanuel. Who will be the most surprised? At the end of the season, to lift everyone's spirits, Pierre suggests a call-and-response song for the whole group.

programme.title: Plus Qu'Hier, Moins Que Demain
programme.desc: On this summer morning, no one is expecting Sonia, who reappears in the village, among her own people, after a long absence, with her baby and her husband. Determined to wipe the slate clean, the young woman brings painful memories back to the surface. Sorrows, confessions, the violence of feelings, an overlooked gem of French cinema.

programme.title: En Voiture Clara
programme.desc: Clara is 17 years old today. As part of a surprise and to create a diversion, her father, Gilles, takes her to a deserted parking lot for a driving lesson. Nothing will go as planned.

programme.desc: Disabled following a work accident, Yara spends his time at home assembling miniature models, under the reproaches of his wife. Drug traffickers have also chosen him to secretly guard their loot. Until the day when some disturbing delivery men show up at his door.

programme.title: Melody
programme.desc: To open her own salon, Melody, a modest home hairdresser, decides to become a surrogate mother. She is soon contacted by Emily, a wealthy Englishwoman in remission from cancer. Between the two women, a complex relationship will develop, by turns friendly and filial, supportive and conflictual.

programme.title: Anushan
programme.desc: The only son of Tamil parents, 13-year-old Anushan much prefers rap to his native culture. When his uncle arrives from Sri Lanka, he finds himself sharing his room and his daily life with him for a few days.

programme.title: Spoon
programme.desc: To escape everyday life and fulfill your dream, it's quite simple: you need a ladder and a spoon.

programme.title: Le Crime Lui Va Si Bien
programme.desc: A man is found in a ditch, killed by a bullet between the eyes. Apparently connected to the Italian mafia, it's the trail Celine Richer enthusiastically decides to follow. programme.title: A L'Ecole Des Vetos
programme.desc: In the anaesthetics department, Charline is looking for her missing dog Gaby. Laurine is doing a work placement on a dairy farm in Aveyron. Pauline discovers the educational herd at the school's equine clinic.

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: There's a tense situation at the industrial port of La Reunion. One of the security guards has laid explosives in a container. Is this ex-serviceman suffering from PTSD or is he just a father under pressure, trying to help his daughter?

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: While Clarissa seeks to understand Dimitri's motives, she also investigates an outbreak of student prostitution on the island. Her team wonder if there's any link between these networks and the theft of a stock of weapons from the French army.

programme.title: Demo De Mode
programme.desc: From her workshops in Rabat, Sara Chraïbi comments on her show presented at the Arab World Institute. A Spring-Summer 2025 collection titled "Les Cieux," directly inspired by a verse from the Quran.

programme.desc: The author Christine Angot returns to Strasbourg, the city where she met her father at the age of 13 and where he raped her for the first time. programme.title: Un Bon Garcon
programme.desc: Max, a talented 16-year-old swimmer, is getting ready to enter the sports studies programme. Between training sessions and outings with his friends, he leads the life of an average teenager. But when the police turn up one day to question his coach, who has been accused of sexual abuse, his regulated life is turned upside down.

programme.title: Foreigners
programme.desc: Jim, 15, is deeply shaken by the arrival of Neil, his British father whom he hasn't seen in five years. The teenager is about to be adopted by his stepfather, with whom he has formed a true bond. But Neil refuses to give up his parental rights...

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Stephane tries to calm several Tourette syndrome crises and has to solve a problem with glasses. Meanwhile, Mike fancies himself a poet, and Caro mourns the loss of a loved one.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Tired of being labeled the worst swimmer, Stephane quits the club. Charles finds an innovative solution to protect Catherine's hair, while Pierre invites the team to make a powerful video to raise donations.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Mike's wheelchair has been stolen. Valerie suggests a solution to help him out. It's time for the club's board meeting in the locker room: an opportunity to gather or just to snack? A special guest puts Stephane in his place.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Sarah receives a very special trophy to reward her efforts. The team is preparing a surprise for Emmanuel. Who will be the most surprised? At the end of the season, to lift everyone's spirits, Pierre suggests a call-and-response song for the whole group.

programme.title: Plus Qu'Hier, Moins Que Demain
programme.desc: On this summer morning, no one is expecting Sonia, who reappears in the village, among her own people, after a long absence, with her baby and her husband. programme.desc: Disabled following a work accident, Yara spends his time at home assembling miniature models, under the reproaches of his wife. Drug traffickers have also chosen him to secretly guard their loot. Until the day when some disturbing delivery men show up at his door.
